note: Matinee's line for a pick. A pick draws its reveal line, and after 'Not that one' its nope line, from the category the viewer's first answer led to; a category with no lines of its own for a set draws that set from universal. 'borrow' names a category that draws from another's lines. The caps are character counts set by rendering every line as the pick line (28 px in 320 px on a 360 px phone, 40 px in 400 px on the widest desktop): 'line' is the longest line that fits in three lines at both, 'pair' is one less than the shortest same-category nope and reveal pair that overflows four lines at either.
